title: Portrait Realism
copy: A monochrome digital illustration created entirely in Adobe Photoshop. The most challenging part was capturing the subtle emotion reflected in her eyes.

title: Portrait Semi-Realism
copy: A traditional fine art piece created with pen and watercolor. Focused on layering complex watercolor techniques to add depth to the skin and eyes, with vibrant hair to contrast the minimal composition.

title: Portrait Semi-Realism
copy: A traditional drawing focused on doll-like features and expressive eyes. Inspired by a favorite dress that sold out—this piece imagines how it would look if it were mine, capturing the femininity and mood of the design.
